benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible dining purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). No enrollment required. Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free night award redeemable at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels for a redemption level of up to 85,000 points, toppable with up to 25,000 additional points for awards up to 110,000 points.
benefits.terms: Issued after card renewal. Can be topped up with up to 25,000 of the cardholder's own points for a total redemption value of up to 110,000 points. Certain hotels charge resort fees not covered by the award.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, plus 25 Elite Night Credits toward the next tier each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic upon Card Membership; no minimum spend required.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership, granting access to over 1,800 airport lounges worldwide with up to two complimentary guests.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to two complimentary guests per visit.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck (5-year membership) application fee.
benefits.terms: Up to $120 for Global Entry or up to $85 for TSA PreCheck, but not both, no more than once per 4-year period. Global Entry approval includes TSA PreCheck access at no extra cost.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for stays of two nights or more at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis properties.
benefits.terms: Requires a minimum 2-night stay. Applies per qualifying booking rather than a fixed annual cap; no single renewalPeriod fits, treat as available whenever a qualifying booking is made.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
